transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. Well... I suppose it's about my eating. 

Late at night, I start picking at the leftovers. And... I don't know, it feels like the sensible part of me is saying, 'That’s enough, Alejandro,' but... my hand just keeps going back for more anyway.
Do you find yourself eating large amounts of food in a short period, even when you’re not really hungry?

I suppose... yes. A lot of the time, I'm not really hungry at all. I mean, I usually have a perfectly good dinner with everyone earlier in the evening. But later on... I just find myself opening the leftover containers... just tasting one thing after another.
When you're eating these leftovers late at night, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating?
Yes... I suppose that's the trouble. I just... I can't seem to stop. Like I said before, I know I shouldn't be eating it, but... I just keep doing it anyway.
After these late-night eating episodes, do you feel upset, guilty, or ashamed about what you've eaten?
Yes... I suppose I do. I just... I feel rather foolish about it all. It's not something I like to think about after it happens.
Do these eating episodes usually happen in a discrete period of time, like within a couple of hours, and during that time do you feel like you can't control the eating at all?

Well... yes, it usually happens pretty quickly. Some nights right after supper... I'll be the one supposed to be putting away the tamales, or the mole. And in just that short time, I end up eating several extra servings. 

Sometimes I'll even take some pan dulce out to the garage. I... I'd never put that much on a plate if the family was watching. But once I start clearing the food away, I just... yeah, I can't seem to stop it.
During these episodes, would you say you feel a complete loss of control, like you're powerless to stop eating even if you wanted to?

I... yeah. I guess you could say that. It's just... once I start picking at the leftovers, it feels like the sensible part of me is right there saying, "That’s enough, Alejandro." But... my hand just keeps going back for more anyway. I just... I don't stop it.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever make yourself sick, fast, use laxatives, or exercise excessively to try to make up for the food you ate?
No... no, I don't do any of those things. I just... I just go to bed.
Do these late-night eating episodes usually happen when you're alone, like in secret, or do they happen in front of others too?

Always alone. I... I make sure to wait until the house is quiet. Or, like I said, out in the garage. 

I just... I'd be embarrassed, I guess, if my cousin or the rest of the family saw how much I was having. I'm... I'm supposed to be the disciplined one. So, no, never in front of them.
Would you say that these late-night eating episodes happen all in one sitting, like within a short time frame, rather than spread out over a long period?

Yeah, it's... it's all in one sitting. Pretty fast. Like, after supper, when I'm supposed to be putting away the tamales or the mole... I just eat it right then. Several servings. Then I might take some pan dulce out to the garage. It's... well, it's a lot more food than I'd ever put on a normal plate if the family was there. But yes... it's all at once.
